label: frozen
prediction: Recorded 2026-09-29 before submission. F14b (design/sc27-plan.md): the per-core end of the priority-domain sweep, in its own job because 56 x 1 has never run past one node (896 and 3584 LCI ranks) and a failed arm drops a graph's other arms. Freeze heap, widths as F14. frozen = 8 x 7; no_share = 8 x 7 with --process-share off (56 independent queues per node, distances still shared in memory); p56 = 56 x 1 (56 independent queues, every update between workers a message, the HavoqGT decomposition). Three held-out sources, one warmup, two repetitions. Predictions: every solve returns the reference digest; candidate over no_share 4.8-15x (F10); over p56 5-20x, at least as large as over no_share on every input; attempts per edge for p56 within 1.5x of no_share's. Revised 2026-09-29 after 5570495/5570496 (not a result): 56 x 1 with LCI's defaults aborts at start-up in register_memory (ENOSPC), because the packet pool (8 KB x 65536 packets) is registered per process, 28 GB per node at 56 processes. p56 therefore runs with LCI_ATTR_NPACKETS=9362 (65536 / 7, the same 4 GB per node as 8 x 7) and one LCI device per process (+lci_ndevices = +ppn = 1).
